page_title: BAR 3-2 CEL | Barcelona v Celta Vigo 23/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+6' Carlos Dotor (Celta Vigo) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
90+4' Rafael Benitez has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Carlos Dotor (Celta Vigo) replacing Jonathan Bamba.
90+4' Unai Nunez comes off the pitch to be replaced by Miguel Rodriguez (Celta Vigo).
90+4' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) makes a yard for himself inside the box after an accurate pass and takes a shot that goes just wide of the right post.
90' 7 additional min. will be played.

89' 3 - 2 Joao Cancelo (Barcelona) meets a perfect cross from Gavi deep inside the box and controls it with a nice first touch. He produces an accurate strike into the bottom left corner. The score is 3:2.
88' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.

88' Joao Cancelo (Barcelona) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender. Barcelona force a corner. They send men into the box.
87' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.

85' 2 - 2 Goal! Joao Cancelo plays in Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona), who shows great determination to get to the ball before a couple of defenders and from inside the box slots it into the bottom left corner 2:2.

84' Luca de la Torre (Celta Vigo) is all over the pitch today. He is full of energy and asking for the ball, while his ability to control the game and to be on the ball is simply fantastic. Every manager wants to have a playmaker like him.
81' 1 - 2 Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) receives an accurate low pass inside the box and scores! His shot ricochets in off the crossbar. What a strike!
78' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo) replaces Iago Aspas.
76' 0 - 2 GOAL! Anastasios Douvikas (Celta Vigo) runs onto a pass from Iago Aspas after great counter attacking play and hits a fine first-time shot into the net from mid range. It’s now 0:2.
75' A cross is whipped into the box by Gavi (Barcelona) and Ilkay Gundogan controls it well. He lines up the ball, but one of the defenders produces a timely intervention.
74' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
74' Joao Felix (Barcelona) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. The linesman makes the right call and Barcelona will have a corner.

73' Alejandro Balde (Barcelona) superbly controls a difficult pass on the edge of the box and effortlessly let's fly with a magnificent low strike towards the middle of the goal, which the keeper somehow pushes away.
72' A substitution has been made. Ferran Torres is replaced by Raphinha (Barcelona).
71' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.

71' That was a nice football moment. Jonathan Bamba (Celta Vigo) receives an amazing defence-splitting low pass on the edge of the box and blasts the ball towards the top left corner. Marc-Andre ter Stegen guesses his intention and dives superbly to deny him with a remarkable save!
70' Flag up against Lamine Yamal (Barcelona). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
70' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) and Robert Lewandowski try to prise open the opposition with a series of short passes, but one of the defenders steps in and puts an end to the move.
69' Joao Cancelo (Barcelona) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Ivan Villar intercepts the ball.
68' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) tries to find Anastasios Douvikas, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
67' A great run from Ferran Torres (Barcelona) ends with a shot inside the box that flashes just past the left post.
66' Rafael Benitez prepares a substitution. Jorgen Strand Larsen is replaced by Anastasios Douvikas (Celta Vigo).
64' Golden chance! Ferran Torres (Barcelona) meets a cross in the box and finds some space for a shot. He produces an inaccurate effort that goes wide of the right post.
63' The attendance for today's match is 43272.
62' Joao Cancelo (Barcelona) sends a cross into the box, but Ivan Villar comes off his line to gather the ball.
60' It will be a substitution. Alejandro Balde (Barcelona) is ready to enter the pitch as Andreas Christensen walks off.
60' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Celta Vigo.
59' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
57' Ivan Villar blocks Ronald Araujo (Barcelona)'s effort from the edge of the box.
57' Barcelona are ruled offside.
56' Fran Beltran (Celta Vigo) gets the ball and drives a shot high over the bar from the edge of the area.
55' 1:4 – this is the current number of shots on target.
55' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) has time on the edge of the box. His shot is disappointing, though, as it flies towards the middle of the goal where Marc-Andre ter Stegen makes a comfortable save.
51' Lamine Yamal plays the ball through to Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) on the edge of the box, he turns and shoots but it's a fraction wide of the left post.
50' Jonathan Bamba (Celta Vigo) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
49' Mihailo Ristic (Celta Vigo) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear. The ball is out of play. Celta Vigo will take a throw-in.
46' Xavi has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Lamine Yamal comes on the pitch for Marcos Alonso (Barcelona).
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Xavi probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Oriol Romeu (Barcelona). He is replaced by Ronald Araujo.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+4' Mario Melero Lopez has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+3' Jonathan Bamba almost gets into in a promising position, but the through ball by Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) from just inside the box is intercepted by one of the defending players.

45+1' Jonathan Bamba (Celta Vigo) brilliantly evades multiple challenges and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the roof of the net. It's a weak effort, however, and is easily saved by Marc-Andre ter Stegen.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
43' Ilkay Gundogan (Barcelona) takes a short pass in his stride and attempts to beat the keeper from mid-range, but the shot screeches just wide of the right post.
43' Unai Nunez (Celta Vigo) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
41' Luca de la Torre (Celta Vigo) misses a rebound from the penalty spot. The ball flies just a few inches over the bar.
39' Gavi (Barcelona) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Mario Melero Lopez had an easy-decision to make.
38' Joao Felix (Barcelona) is well placed to meet a cross and sends a difficult header towards the left post, but the goalkeeper reacts well to stop the effort.
36' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Frenkie de Jong departs the field of play to be replaced by Gavi (Barcelona).
36' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Andreas Christensen (Barcelona) was quite harsh and Mario Melero Lopez didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
33' Ferran Torres (Barcelona) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
33' Jorgen Strand Larsen (Celta Vigo) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
31' The game is interrupted now, Jorgen Strand Larsen (Celta Vigo) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
30' Marcos Alonso (Barcelona) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and bends his effort inches wide of the left post.
30' Ferran Torres (Barcelona) and Joao Cancelo combine brilliantly in a series of one-twos.
28' Good movement by Jules Kounde (Barcelona), but he can't find any of his teammates as the cross is poor.

27' Luca de la Torre nearly gets in a one-on-one with the goalkeeper after a defence-splitting pass from Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo), but one of the defenders makes a clearance to snuff out the chance.
24' Good chance! Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) nicely turned his man inside the box but placed his effort just wide of the right post. He should have scored!
23' Ilkay Gundogan does a good job setting up Joao Felix (Barcelona) on the edge of the box, but his nice effort curls just over the bar.
22' Jonathan Bamba (Celta Vigo) attempts to find Jorgen Strand Larsen with a delicate little through ball from inside the box, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.
19' 0 - 1 Goal - 0:1! Jorgen Strand Larsen (Celta Vigo) gets a shot away from the edge of the box and scores into the bottom right corner. Luca de la Torre provided an assist for the goal.
19' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.

18' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger. It will be a corner kick for Celta Vigo.

18' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the roof of the net, but Marc-Andre ter Stegen pulls off a brilliant save. The referee signals a corner kick to Celta Vigo.
16' Frenkie de Jong (Barcelona) makes a slide tackle, but referee Mario Melero Lopez blows for a foul.
12' Luca de la Torre (Celta Vigo) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post.
11' A lofted cross from Oriol Romeu (Barcelona) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
9' Joao Felix (Barcelona) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
8' A cross from Marcos Alonso (Barcelona) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Barcelona.
7' Frenkie de Jong (Barcelona) and Marcos Alonso combine well with a quick one-two to trick their opponent.
4' Barcelona keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Barcelona will kick the game off.
Mario Melero Lopez got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
